toolMode: OpenAI built-in image generation and image editing
fitPromptTemplate: Create one exact 4x4, 16-direction registered standing-character sprite atlas for {character} wearing {garment}. Preserve the canonical character identity, anatomy, mane, tail, face, pose order, scale and position. Reconstruct the garment consistently through front, quarter, profile, rear-quarter and rear views, with correct fabric, seams, cuffs, collar and reference-specific details. Keep the lower body, legs and hooves unchanged. Use a transparent background and do not add props, text, shadows, scenery or extra characters.
itemOnlyEditPromptTemplate: From this fitted 4x4 atlas, make a pixel-registered garment-only extraction. Preserve the exact 16-cell layout, pose, scale and garment position. Remove the character head, muzzle, ears, eyes, mane, tail, body, legs, hooves and accessories. Retain only {garment}, including all visible sleeves, cuffs, hem, collar and reference-specific construction. Use genuine transparency; remove every stray speck and halo. Do not move, mirror, resize, repaint or rearrange the garment.
deterministicPostProcessing: palette and connected-component cleanup of extraction speckles
canonical guide alignment limited to plus or minus 6 pixels
zero alpha in each cell at local y greater than or equal to 214
